text:
sasha: Heads-up — launching a targeted admin prune for Payments + Analytics this week. Found ~12 org-admin grants flagged as inactive in the last quarterly audit. Goal: remove stale grants while preserving KMS decrypt for billing pipelines. Quick plan below, need :thumbsup: and any blockers.

devon: +1. Curious about svcacct-billing — if we remove org-admin, will it lose kms/decrypt? Any pre-checks?

sasha: Good call. We tagged svcacct-billing as dependent. Plan: 1) create dedicated KMS binding 'projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/billing/cryptoKeys/billing-decryptor' 2) grant only that binding to svcacct-billing 3) run smoke decrypt tests 4) remove org-admin binding.

maria: I'll own the KMS binding creation. Need an owners list for the services we change so we can notify quickly if something fails.

sasha: Owners: @devon (platform), @maria (infra), @aj (oncall). I'll add them to the checklist and update the runbook.

aj: Timeline + rollback? What's the canary plan if decrypt fails in prod?

sasha: Canary: candidate rollout to staging first, then 10% of production jobs for 24h. If decrypt errors spike -> automatic rollback to previous IAM binding. Rollback steps in runbook. We'll monitor auditlog filter and job error rates.

devon: I'll add a CI smoke test "kms-decrypt-test" that hits the same key path with svcacct-billing impersonation. If that fails, PR blocks.

access-scan-bot: Automated scan result: ownerless admin grants found: 7; svcacct-billing listed as "has KMS access via org-admin". See /security/scans/17355 for details.

sasha: Thanks bot. Action items condensed: 
- maria: create billing-decryptor key binding (before Tue EOD)
- devon: add kms-decrypt-test to CI (PR by Wed)
- sasha: prepare RBAC PR to remove org-admin grants incrementally (canary policy in PR)
- aj: connect oncall run and alert thresholds (before rollout)

maria: noted. One question: do we want to migrate existing encrypted blobs to the new key or just keep key as a wrapper?

devon: Prefer keep wrapper (same key) to avoid re-encrypt mass ops. We'll only change access bindings so decryption still works.

sasha: Agreed. We'll avoid rekeying for this sweep.

aj: For monitoring, recommend these alert filters: 
- protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND severity>=ERROR
- metric:cloudfunctions/function/execution_count for billing pipelines with >5% error increase

sasha: Adding both to the canary dashboard.

devon: One more thing — ensure audit logs have the request.auth.principalEmail stored for the decrypt calls. If not, we may need to enable principal logging on the key.

maria: I'll verify audit config and enable principal logging if missing.

opsbot: Scheduled: RBAC prune canary window 2024-07-09T02:00Z -> 2024-07-09T06:00Z. Notification will be sent to #incidents if errors > threshold.

sasha: Perfect. If no objections I'll open the RBAC PR and tag reviewers. Will also post the checklist and rollback commands.

devon: :thumbsup: from me.

maria: :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread: short, technical coordination for admin entitlement cleanup + KMS binding plan. Single string of messages in chronological order.
